definitions.explanation: The fixed amount of time allowed for something — an exam, a game, a speech, a parking space, an all-you-can-eat meal. Formed from {制限|せいげん} (restriction) + {時間|じかん} (time).

examples.japanese: {制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{九十分|きゅうじゅっぷん}です。
examples.english: The time limit is ninety minutes.

examples.japanese: {制限時間内|せいげんじかんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{全問|ぜんもん}→全問：27469_zenmon⟧⟦{答|こた}えられなかった→答える：01099_kotaeru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't answer all the questions within the time limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{食|た}べ{放題|ほうだい}→食べ放題：08291_tabehoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: This all-you-can-eat has a fixed two-hour time limit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えて→超える：01942_koeru⟧しまい、⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{話|はな}せなかった→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I went over the time limit for my presentation and couldn't finish what I wanted to say.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to set a time limit
- {制限時間内|せいげんじかんない}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: within the time limit
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the time limit
- {制限時間|せいげんじかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: for the time limit to run out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧: deadline — a point in time by which something is due, not a duration
- ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧: term, expiry — a longer official validity period, as on a contract or a passport
